card_text: One road south from Roswell: about 90 minutes on US 285, through Artesia.

seo.title: Barber for Roswell, NM: 76 Miles South in Carlsbad
seo.description: Divinely Faded is in Carlsbad, about 76 miles south of Roswell on US 285, roughly an hour and a half. Book on Booksy before you head south.

tim_questions: Do clients come down from Roswell? If yes, the page can say so in your words.

paragraphs: Divinely Faded is in Carlsbad, {{city:roswell.drive_mi}} miles south of Roswell. It's {{city:roswell.route}} the whole way, through Artesia at about the halfway mark, and it takes around {{city:roswell.drive_min}} minutes.
Here's what to sort out before you head south: what to book, when I'm open and exactly where the shop is.

blocks.heading: Straight down 285.
paragraphs: Take {{city:roswell.route}} south out of Roswell and stay on it. Artesia comes up about halfway; keep going and you're in Carlsbad.
The shop is at {{address}}. Tap Get Directions above and Google Maps handles the last few turns.
Leave a little slack for town traffic at the Carlsbad end. If you're going to be late, text me at {{phone}}.

blocks.lead: Not every trip needs a long appointment. These fit around an errand day in Carlsbad.

items.title: Essential Haircut
items.body: A full cut, razor-clean neckline and a finished style, without a long sit.

items.title: Straight Razor Beard Shave
items.body: A traditional wet shave with hot towels and shaving cream.

items.title: Express Facial
items.body: Massage, steam, cleanse, exfoliation and moisturizer in half an hour.

items.title: Kids' haircuts
items.body: Each child needs their own time on Booksy; line them up right after yours.

items.q: How far is Divinely Faded from Roswell?
items.a: About {{city:roswell.drive_mi}} miles, or around {{city:roswell.drive_min}} minutes south on {{city:roswell.route}}.
Yes. US 285 runs straight through Artesia, roughly halfway between Roswell and Carlsbad.

items.q: Can I book the same day?
items.a: Only if Booksy shows an open time that day. Check before you leave Roswell, since I work by appointment only.
Cash, card, Zelle or Cash App, after the service.
